name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Overhead Press
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one kettlebell in the front rack position with your forearm vertical and wrist straight.
Squeeze your glutes, brace your abs, and make a firm fist with your free hand out to the side to build full-body tension.
Press the bell overhead until your elbow straightens and your wrist is stacked above your shoulder.
Lower the bell smoothly back into the front rack position, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning sideways away from the working arm.
Keep your wrist neutral so the weight stacks directly over your forearm.
